body:
Nullable changes Expr[T] to Expr[*T] without inserting a SQL cast or changing nullability in the database. Use nullable destinations for outer-join missing rows and nullable columns; AssertNotNull is an assertion, not a runtime filter. A non-null declaration does not make a LEFT JOIN result non-null. Check the query shape and actual scan errors rather than treating zero values as missing data.

Evidence: ds:block?id=column-and-null-p2fy3sp5; ds:block?id=null-scan-9xxzyqc7. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
title: NULL changes the result type, not the SQL
